targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('month', observation_date)::timestamp + INTERVAL '12 hours' AS "time", SUM(rainfall_in) AS "Total rainfall" FROM daily_weather_summary WHERE $__timeFilter(observation_date::timestamp + INTERVAL '12 hours') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('month', observation_date)::timestamp + INTERVAL '12 hours' AS "time", AVG(high_temp_f) AS "Average high", AVG(low_temp_f) AS "Average low" FROM daily_weather_summary WHERE $__timeFilter(observation_date::timestamp + INTERVAL '12 hours') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('month', observation_date)::timestamp + INTERVAL '12 hours' AS "time", MAX(peak_gust_mph) AS "Maximum gust" FROM daily_weather_summary WHERE $__timeFilter(observation_date::timestamp + INTERVAL '12 hours') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('month', observation_date)::timestamp + INTERVAL '12 hours' AS "time", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rainfall_in > 0)::double precision AS "Rainy days" FROM daily_weather_summary WHERE $__timeFilter(observation_date::timestamp + INTERVAL '12 hours') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('month', observation_date)::timestamp + INTERVAL '12 hours' AS "time", SUM(lightning_strikes)::double precision AS "Lightning strikes" FROM daily_weather_summary WHERE $__timeFilter(observation_date::timestamp + INTERVAL '12 hours') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH months AS (SELECT generate_series(1, 12) AS month_num), totals AS (SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM observation_date)::int AS month_num, SUM(rainfall_in) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM observation_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)) AS current_year, SUM(rainfall_in) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM observation_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1) AS previous_year FROM daily_weather_summary WHERE observation_date >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 year' AND observation_date < date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY 1) SELECT to_char(make_date(2000, months.month_num, 1), 'Mon') AS "Month", totals.current_year AS "Current year", totals.previous_year AS "Previous year" FROM months LEFT JOIN totals USING (month_num) ORDER BY months.month_num

WITH months AS (SELECT generate_series(1, 12) AS month_num), temps AS (SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM observation_date)::int AS month_num, AVG(high_temp_f) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM observation_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)) AS current_high, AVG(high_temp_f) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM observation_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1) AS previous_high, AVG(low_temp_f) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM observation_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)) AS current_low, AVG(low_temp_f) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM observation_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1) AS previous_low FROM daily_weather_summary WHERE observation_date >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 year' AND observation_date < date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY 1) SELECT to_char(make_date(2000, months.month_num, 1), 'Mon') AS "Month", temps.current_high AS "Current-year high", temps.previous_high AS "Previous-year high", temps.current_low AS "Current-year low", temps.previous_low AS "Previous-year low" FROM months LEFT JOIN temps USING (month_num) ORDER BY months.month_num
